svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 07 · Riverside · 11/12 The Parent Navel (Common)
svg.desc: An old navel orange tree behind a little fence at a busy corner. A lot of groves trace back to it. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
